note: kaggle-l4-seq-c150k-wrap-w9h-dual.json with codex stream_idle_timeout_ms 90,000 (default 300,000): Runpod reproduction arm (10-24) of the C128 retry storm -- sglang holds a tool-carrying request's message (compaction summary, 171-290 s at C128) and a qwen3_coder parameter until done, codex drops a stream silent for longer than the idle timeout and resends; 90 s makes every compaction and long tool call trip it. Not for Kaggle. Base: kaggle-l4-seq-c150k-wrap.json (codex2wr, 7f23625) with four changes (user 2026-10-24, for the C128 L4 submission). (1) task_wall_seconds 32,400 (was 21,600): a Kaggle rerun schedule simulation over the student-trajectory QAD R eval120 run (480 episodes, Kaggle scheduling rules, rate calibrated to the 10-22 Save & Run) has C128 solvers that use their whole budget hit the 6 h wall once the per-stream rate is 0.8x the Save & Run one; 9 h removes those wall stops in every slowed scenario; the 700-minute deadline still caps every episode. (2) ind_prompts v3dual: s2 runs prompts v3dual (v3 plus an optional self-contained solution2.py for a second reading that passes every training pair; docs/research/arc2_dual_solver_20261023.md); s0 stays v3. (3) second_solution solution2.py: the harness harvests it from s0 / s2 like solution.py; it counts only when it passes every training pair, and only where its output differs from the episode's first answer. (4) refine_prompts v3refine-dual: the refiners see each candidate's second answer (candidates/<X>/test_J_output2.json, check.txt) and the summary in the brief; the ind fallback and the refiners' fill take second answers after both solvers' first answers. The rest as in the base config: Kaggle L4x4 two attempts per task + wrap-up + re-refiner filler (user 2026-10-13) = kaggle-l4-seq-c150k.json (the 57109034 submission's config: s0 + s2 at 200,000 output tokens, refiner refine_exp at 100,000, --solvers-first, each episode on the least busy DP, posix fence without netns, window 150,000 / compact 100,000, xhigh, prompts v3) with three changes. (1) No 65k midpoint reminder: it was added for a 100k cap without compaction, never measured a gain (G4 v5 vs v3c +14/-12), and now fires in every context window saying 'half the budget' at about a quarter. (2) wrapup_tokens 32,000: when the 200,000 budget is used, the proxy's response-end hook writes the wrap-up message (prompts v3/wrapup.md: write the best rule into solution.py, run check.py, write notes.md, stop) into codex's compact_reminder, and patch 0005 injects it into the running turn at the next follow-up -- same thread, same effort, prefix cache kept; the proxy stops the session at 232,000. Refiners get half (16,000, prompts v3refine/wrapup.md: fill final/). 32,000 because the response crossing the line still has 9.8k to go on average (b200 eval120 x2, 10,311 solver responses; token-weighted p90 response 51k). features.pre_compact_reminder stays on (the wrap-up uses it). (3) task_wall_seconds 21,600 (was 14,400): about 15 tok/s per stream at C96 makes 232,000 about 4.3 h. kaggle_run adds the re-refiner filler (rerefine: an independent second refine_exp in slots the main line can no longer use; while main episodes remain only with --filler-guard 7,200 s left to the deadline -- they take no slot but slow every step of the main line's tail, and a 60-minute guard cut 1-5 more main episodes in the 10-13 schedule simulation -- and --filler-min-left 3,600 s once the main line is done) and submits refine_vote (refine_exp and the re-refiner voted, a1 two votes, a2 one). max_failures 9 as before.
